_about: JBL headphones and earbuds PairFree can talk to, from JBL Headphones 5.37.10 (jbl.stc.com): name, product ids (pid) and connection from its product_list.json, the settings JBL's app shows for the model from its config (dash4), and how the model's control class sends them (docs/jbl/PROTOCOL.md section 5). family is direct (one command per setting), feature (Harman's feature records, command 06) or p4 (JBL's protocol 4, frames starting 00 DD); noise is modes (command 91), old (31 and 32), club (31 and 32, off without 32), asc (protocol 4: ambient sound control and the mode) or mode4 (protocol 4: the mode feature alone); auto_off is v1 (one byte), v2 (three bytes), feature or p4. security is JBL's protocol 4 BLE security mode (1 to 3; docs/jbl/PROTOCOL.md section 7), absent for 0. Models on Airoha's SDK or LE Audio, and models JBL's app has no config for, are left out (docs/devices/jbl.md). tried names the open-source project that used the same commands on the model; reports lists device reports under data/jbl/reports.
